verdict.rationale: The evidence shows OpenCode can discover reusable instructions from the repo as agent skills, but these load on demand through the skill tool rather than as an always-applied conventions file. It also supports custom agents with their own system prompts, and a project 'initialize' command exists, but the pack never says that command creates an instructions file. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a persistent project instructions file (e.g., AGENTS.md) that the agent always follows, confirmation of what the init command produces, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
